title: Sync upstream main: second viewer window, Immich album organising, option to hide collapsed side panels
notes: Conflicts kept both sides. The viewer window's per-window GPU display keeps RapidRoom's pending-surface-size resize handling for the main window only; the preview job keeps RapidRoom's perf spans, image-cache hash and lens snapshot resolution after upstream's earlier settings/content-hash step; the Immich conflict-copy helpers stay on RapidRoom's sidecar locking and also back the new upload adoption; editor wheel zoom keeps RapidRoom's percent stepping on top of upstream's shared wheel gesture helper, and click zoom keeps RapidRoom's percent targets. Not run locally: the Rust build was blocked by the network policy, so hosted CI is the first full build.
